overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Chair's virtual-meeting announcement plus a roll call of each remote member's name and presence adequately identified remote participants. No order issued.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to announce the name of each member who participated remotely at its March 1, 2021 Zoom meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the combination of the Chair’s announcement that the meeting was being held virtually followed by a roll call in which each Board member stated his name and that he was present clearly and effectively conveyed to the public the identity of all Board members who were participating remotely, and fulfilled the transparency goals of the Open Meeting Law.
